decisions: This repository is independent of build-a-web-page-for-ios.
Hardware target is original ESP32 integrated TWAI plus NXP TJA1051T/3 SO8.
S00 environment inventory is complete; unresolved hardware, target compiler and Proteus API items are tracked as downstream dependencies.
ESP-IDF/TWAI remains the preferred firmware API candidate; select/pin an actually buildable toolchain in S02 after exact target confirmation.
Default runtime state must be passive/listen-only with a hardware-enforced transmitter inhibit.
Vehicle CAN identifiers, bus bit rate, topology, and signal mappings remain unknown until supported by evidence.
No official Python API/utility for native Proteus schematic generation was confirmed in local examples or official public resources reviewed; S09 must verify the route rather than invent one.
No application implementation or physical hardware validation has been performed.
open_questions: Exact ESP32 module/board and accessible GPIOs, because no board was detected at S00 inspection
Classic ESP32 target toolchain installation and reproducible version pinning
Proteus activation/licensed modules and native import/render behavior
Supported official native schematic automation/generation route, if any
Verified bus bit rate(s), topology, protocol/frame format, and safely available capture points for the target vehicle
